run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to process ASE atoms objects and generate UMA fine-tuning dataset YAML configs
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML config files for UMA model fine-tuning with dataset paths, normalizer RMSD, and linear reference coefficients
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing of ASE atoms objects from a directory into a structured output path
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
refactor_create_yaml_for_new_task: refactor create_yaml to support a new UMA task type or additional regression task configuration
